listings.description: Woogies at the Carew Arms is a well-established, chef-led pub and restaurant in the village of Antony, near Torpoint, Cornwall, offered for sale together with the valuable benefit of two rented residential flats producing a steady income alongside the trade. The business has been run by the current owner for the past seven years, and the premises have traded as a pub for considerably longer, giving the site genuine standing in its community. The kitchen is led by the owner, a chef by trade who trained at university before studying in France and Italy, and the quality of the food offer sits at the heart of the business’s strong local reputation. Her partner runs front of house, supported by two part-time staff, and the business can comfortably be run by a team of three or four people. With a turnover of approximately £242,796, a net profit of approximately £79,000 and additional rental income from the two flats, this is a genuinely profitable lifestyle business with substance. Buyers should note that the current trading name is retained by the seller and does not transfer, so the business will trade under a different name after completion. – Turnover approximately £242,796 – Net profit approximately £79,000 – Two residential flats let at £1,450 and £1,000 per month, all bills included – Chef-led kitchen with a strong local reputation – Run by the current owner for seven years – Lean operation, easily run by a team of three or four – Stock available in addition at valuation The business operates as a pub and restaurant with a chef-led kitchen. The owner personally leads all the cooking, bringing formal training and experience gained in France and Italy, while her partner manages front of house. The combination of a quality food offer and a traditional pub setting has earned the business a really good name locally, with consistent trade built on its established following. The two residential flats above provide a reliable secondary income stream. Previously let through Airbnb, the flats are now let on six-month agreements with all bills included, which the owner has found far easier to manage and which deliver steady, predictable income month after month. The business is located in Antony, a village close to Torpoint in Cornwall. It occupies an established position within its village community and has built its trade around a loyal local following over many years, in one of the UK’s most popular counties for hospitality operators. The premises comprise the pub and restaurant together with two self-contained residential flats, held on a leasehold basis. The trading areas are fitted out for food and drink service, with a kitchen equipped for the chef-led menu, including ovens and fryers, and a furnished front of house.

This characterful thoroughfare accommodates a diverse mix of independent retailers, cafés, restaurants and bars. The harbour and Custom House Quay are close by, while Discovery Quay, Events Square and the National Maritime Museum Cornwall are within easy walking distance. The central setting provides opportunities to attract local residents and visitors exploring Falmouth’s shops, waterfront and maritime attractions, making this an appealing location for a hospitality business. Business Description Veritas Business Sales is delighted to offer for sale this stylish cocktail bar and restaurant occupying a desirable trading position in the heart of Falmouth. Our clients extensively refurbished and transformed the premises before opening in April 2024. Their investment included redecoration and the installation of a comprehensive range of quality fixtures, fittings and commercial catering equipment. The business is now offered for sale so that they can focus on their property development interests. The business is operated by the owners, supported by seven part-time members of staff. Our clients report average weekly turnover of approximately £10,000 during the summer months, with drinks accounting for around 70% of sales and the Latin American food offering contributing the remaining 30%. The premises are presented in excellent condition, with tables, chairs and bench seating providing approximately 35 internal covers. External seating for approximately 18 customers further enhances the offering. There is potential to develop the food menu and explore additional winter opening days, subject to demand and the premises licence. This represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a distinctive hospitality business with an established trading presence, substantial reported summer sales and an extensive fit-out. Early viewing is highly recommended.
